mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS evalCount, ROUND(AVG(score_timeliness), 2) AS avgTimeliness, ROUND(AVG(score_quality), 2) AS avgQuality, ROUND(AVG(score_attitude), 2) AS avgAttitude, ROUND(AVG(score_professional), 2) AS avgProfessional, ROUND(AVG(score_overall), 2) AS avgOverall FROM advisor_evaluation WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND teacher_id = #{teacherId}
SELECT tags FROM advisor_evaluation WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND tags IS NOT NULL

SELECT teacher_id AS teacherId, COUNT(*) AS evalCount, ROUND(AVG(score_overall), 2) AS avgOverall FROM advisor_evaluation WHERE is_deleted = 0
AND create_time >= #{beginDate}
AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY teacher_id

SELECT p.college_id AS collegeId, c.college_name AS collegeName, COUNT(*) AS evalCount, ROUND(AVG(ae.score_overall), 2) AS avgOverall FROM advisor_evaluation ae JOIN paper_info p ON ae.paper_id = p.id LEFT JOIN college c ON p.college_id = c.id WHERE ae.is_deleted = 0
AND ae.create_time >= #{beginDate}
AND ae.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY p.college_id, c.college_name
